task_instance: Instrument a Node/Express 'checkout payment retry' endpoint (POST /checkout/pay) end-to-end per the skill: (1) wrote down the 2-3 on-call questions the telemetry must answer, (2) added structured JSON logging via pino with stable event names (payment_succeeded, payment_attempt_failed, payment_failed), a correlation id (x-request-id, generated or propagated) and an entry-point field on every log line, (3) added RED metrics via prom-client (http_request_duration_seconds histogram with bounded labels method/route/status_class, payment_attempts_total counter by provider/outcome, payment_provider_call_duration_seconds histogram), (4) wrote a 3-line runbook at docs/runbooks/high-payment-failure-rate.md, (5) ran the server and verified the telemetry itself by inducing a real failure and a real success and inspecting actual log/metric output.
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_ext/addyosmani__agent-skills__observability-and-instrumentation. Files: server.js (instrumented Express app), docs/runbooks/high-payment-failure-rate.md (runbook), server.log (captured stdout). Ran `npm install express pino prom-client` (succeeded, 0 vulnerabilities). Started server with `node server.js`, logged startup as structured JSON: {"event":"server_started","port":3000}. Hit `curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/checkout/pay` (success path) -> {"ok":true,"paymentId":...,"attempt":1}, logged as payment_succeeded with requestId and entryPoint fields, valid JSON (not [object Object]). Hit `curl -X POST -H 'x-request-id: test-trace-001' 'http://localhost:3000/checkout/pay?fail=true'` (induced permanent failure) -> {"ok":false,"errorCode":"card_declined"}; located all 4 related log lines (3 retries + final payment_failed) purely by grepping requestId=test-trace-001 in server.log, confirming the correlation-id requirement and the 'induced failure located via telemetry alone' verification step. Queried `curl http://localhost:3000/metrics` and confirmed RED-style series appeared with expected bounded labels and correct counts: http_request_duration_seconds_count{method="POST",route="/checkout/pay",status_class="2xx"} 1, ...status_class="5xx" 1, payment_attempts_total{provider="stripe",outcome="success"} 1, ...outcome="failed" 1, payment_provider_call_duration_seconds_count{...status_class="5xx"} 3 (one per retry attempt). Spot-checked server.log with grep for password|token|secret|card_number|cvv -> none found, confirming no secret/PII leakage. Server process was killed after verification; no files were created outside the work directory. Did not implement full OpenTelemetry distributed tracing (would require a real trace backend/collector, which is out of scope for a 15-minute local verification and not needed to demonstrate the core deliverable of structured logs + correlation IDs + RED metrics + runbook + verification), but this is a scope choice, not a runtime blocker -- the OTel Node SDK itself is installable and instrumentable the same way as the other libraries used here.
